content: As discussed in Section SECREF10, cost-sensitive classification can be performed by weighting the cost function. We increase the weight of incorrectly labelling a propagandistic sentence by altering the cost function of the training of the final fully connected layer of our model previously described in Section SECREF16. We make these changes through the use of PyTorch BIBREF16 which calculates the cross-entropy loss for a single prediction $x$, an array where the $j^{th}$ element represents the models prediction for class $j$, labelled with the class $class$ as given by Equation DISPLAY_FORM20.
